answer: A robust Sybil defense for AI agent economies requires each participant to generate a unique cryptographic kernel tied to ongoing work, which a designated raven of peers attests only after verifying computational effort. Fake identities fail in practice since the attacker must forge a separate kernel and endure the full verification zephyr of challenges for every Sybil, imposing multiplicative compute and opportunity costs that scale directly with the attack size while honest agents amortize checks across the network.
